label: kizuna_health_c_02
text: Sorry, were you looking for me? I’ve been away\nfrom the nurse’s office lately.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_03
text: Did you need something from me?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_04a
text: Are your Pokémon hurt? Just a sec...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_04b
text: Whaaat? But then why’d you come over to talk?\nOh well, I’ll heal up your Pokémon anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_05
text: Here ya go. A little first aid.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_06
text: You must really be having an adventure out there,\njudging from those scrapes and cuts![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_07
text: Huh? Oh yeah, I guess it is pretty unusual for me\nto be out of the nurse’s office like this.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_08
text: Hehe. Well...I’m actually doing a bit of studying.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_09
text: Thought I’d try my best at the health teacher\ncertification exam one more time.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_10
text: Just so you know, it’s totally NOT because I’m\ninspired by a certain somebody working hard\r\nat their Treasure Hunt, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_11
text: Well...maybe I am just a little bit![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_13
text: Uh-oh! My break time’s almost over![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_14
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I know you’ll be cheering me on,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_c_system_01
text: You feel trusted by Nurse Miriam!
